CFO transitions can affect financing plans, runway communication, and investor confidence in a cash-intensive biotech.
Early process reduces execution risk and signals planned transition rather than abrupt change.
Continuity lowers near-term operational and reporting disruption risk.

This is a planned leadership transition at a clinical-stage biotech reliant on capital markets. A named successor, timeline clarity, and any shift in financing or strategy would turn this into a larger catalyst.
